title: Budget-matched pooling of search and imitation candidates
hypothesis: A shared rollout selector exploits complementary search and imitation trajectories across structures better than spending the same probe budget entirely on either optimizer.

prediction.against: Both equal-budget search-only and imitation-only selectors on the same frozen structures
prediction.rationale: Requiring five points against both controls distinguishes complementarity from merely doubling the candidate budget; D-005 compared optimizers separately rather than pooling them. Requires per-idea GPU approval; stop the remote box afterward.

protocol.command: gpu run -- python scripts/stage_f.py --config config/stage_f/stage_f.yaml --research-protocol pooled-optimizer --anchor-structures baseline61_gen0_cand2_a1,baseline61_gen0_cand1_a0 --additional-source logs/baseline_gpt61_sol_high --additional-count 2 --additional-rule lexicographic-valid-bounded-prior-success-le-0.40 --search-seed 2910 --fit-seed 2911 --probe-seed 2912 --confirmation-seed 2913 --probe-cases 10 --confirmation-cases 50 --search-original-local-global 1,3,4 --imitation-checkpoints 0,125,250,375,500,625,750,1000 --search-control-original-local-global 1,6,8 --imitation-control-checkpoints 0,62,125,187,250,312,375,437,500,562,625,687,750,875,1000 --manifest-dir config/manifests/research/pooled_optimizer --output logs/research/pooled_optimizer_s2910
code_changes: scripts/stage_f.py: extend the existing direct-search versus imitation experiment with a pooled selector and two equal-budget controls; all candidates start from each structure's frozen original parameters.

scripts/stage_f.py: freeze four structure IDs before new rollouts, retaining the two anchors and selecting two additional valid bounded-parameter structures using archived scores and lexical order; fail closed if unavailable. These are optimizer-study subjects, not fittable-lane parents.

scripts/stage_f.py: cache shared candidate evaluations. Each selector sees 15 candidates and 150 probe episodes per structure; the combined experiment evaluates at most 29 unique candidates per structure.

scripts/stage_f.py: freeze disjoint development-only probe and confirmation manifests; evaluate three selected winners per structure on confirmation, average paired differences across structures within placement, and adjust the two paired comparisons for multiplicity. Never select using imitation loss.

falsified_by: An upper paired confidence bound below +0.05 against either control refutes the stated margin. Zero-spanning intervals are inconclusive, and tied success is not improvement. Positive evidence requires multiplicity-adjusted paired lower bounds above zero against both controls.
